title: Flow Library Install: a plugin-only Flow (Transcribe) shows no progress, and a Flow whose model is already downloading cannot queue the rest
description: Fabio 2026-10-11: Transcribe Install pressed twice, nothing visible. flowInstallKeys counts the flow:<id> key only for requiredDeps, but _installMissing starts it for requiredPlugins deps too, so the drawer never sees the job. 360 Pano: Krea2 already downloading turns the footer into bar+Cancel with no Install for the remaining deps.
